validator_notes: MIT license verified at github.com/shadcn-ui/ui/blob/main/LICENSE.md. 114k stars, v4.7.0 released 2026-05-05. Copy-paste component model with Radix primitives + Tailwind; ideal for App Router + TypeScript. Canonical repo, active maintainership, no forks needed.

MIT license verified at github.com/radix-ui/primitives/blob/main/LICENSE (copyright WorkOS 2022). Unstyled, accessible primitives underpinning shadcn/ui. Canonical upstream; stable release cadence. OSI-approved.

MIT license verified at github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/blob/master/LICENSE (Tailwind Labs, Inc.). v4.x actively maintained by original authors. Required baseline for both dashboard and portfolio apps. Also covers @tailwindcss/typography plugin (MIT, github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss-typography/blob/master/LICENSE).

MIT license verified at github.com/recharts/recharts/blob/master/LICENSE. 27.1k stars, v3.8.1 released 2026-03-25, 4,669 commits on main. React-native D3 charting library; well-suited for SDE/revenue trend charts in the dashboard. Actively maintained.

ISC license verified at github.com/lucide-icons/lucide/blob/main/LICENSE. ISC is OSI-approved and functionally equivalent to MIT. Feather-derived icons carry MIT. Official React package is lucide-react on npm (canonical). Default icon set for shadcn/ui — highly coherent pairing.
